name: Warrior
blurb: A brave front-line fighter who wades into the fray and shields his friends. Tough armor, hits hard up close, and gains an extra die when allies gang up on the same foe.

specialAction.name: Whirlwind Attack
specialAction.description: Split your melee dice to make melee attacks at multiple adjacent targets.

bonusAbility.name: Teamwork
bonusAbility.description: When a target is engaged, your attacks against that target gain 1 extra die.

name: Hunter
blurb: A sharp-eyed archer who strikes from afar. Quick on his feet and deadly at range, he can split his arrows across several enemies and slip away the moment he's hit.

specialAction.name: Arrow-Split Shot
specialAction.description: Split your ranged dice to attack multiple targets up to 6 squares away.

bonusAbility.name: Hunter
bonusAbility.description: When you're damaged by an attack, you can immediately move 1 square.

name: Healer
blurb: A gentle mender who keeps the party standing. She casts searing light from range, brews potions, and can pull a wounded ally back from the brink with a healing touch.

specialAction.name: Healing Touch
specialAction.description: Remove 1 damage from yourself or an adjacent ally.

bonusAbility.name: Tangled
bonusAbility.description: When defending melee attacks, you gain 1 extra die to your armor pool.

name: Warlock (Fire)
blurb: A reckless fire-mage who hurls flaming bolts across the room. He burns hotter the more hurt he takes, and can wash every nearby enemy in a burst of flame.

specialAction.name: Flame Burst
specialAction.description: Make 1-die magic attacks at all adjacent targets, including allies.

bonusAbility.name: Power Surge
bonusAbility.description: When you are not at full health, your magic attacks gain 1 extra die.
